title: Studio's record grid does not clamp text cells: one row with a long `description` renders 457px tall against its neighbours' 41px
body:
Studio's record grid does not clamp text cells: one row with a long `description` renders 457px tall against its neighbours' 41px

Measured on `17.1.0` (open edition, `objectstack dev`), Studio → **数据 / Data** → `crm_account` → **记录 / Records**, 10 rows.

Row heights, read off the DOM (`tbody tr` bounding boxes):

```
250 / h41   1  ACC-000010  Skyline Media
291 / h41   2  ACC-000008  Lattice Education
332 / h41   3  ACC-000002  Globex Industries
373 / h41   4  ACC-000005  Wayne Enterprises
414 / h41   5  ACC-000009  Apex Logistics
455 / h457  6  ACC-000001  Acme Corporation      ← 11× its neighbours
911 / h41   7  …
```

Row 6's `描述 / description` holds a multi-line markdown blurb (`"Strategic Customer · Enterprise Tier\nAcme Corporation is a S…"`). The cell renders the whole thing, the row grows to fit, and every cell in that row is stretched to 457px — so the grid shows five rows, a screen-height band of empty cells, and then row 6. Rows 7-10 are pushed below the fold entirely.

The console's *app-side* list views truncate the same field to one line, so this is specific to the Studio metadata console's record grid.

## Expected

A tabular row should be one line tall regardless of cell content: `truncate` / `line-clamp-1` on text cells with the full value in a title/tooltip or the row's detail panel, the way the app-side grids already do it. The current behaviour makes any object with a long-text field unusable in Studio's record tab — and long text on a business object is the common case, not the exception.
